test_GraphsTuple_creation: test the GraphsTuple class raises ValueError when required fields like n_node or n_edge are missing
test_GraphsTuple_replace: test the GraphsTuple.replace method raises ValueError when inconsistent None fields are provided
test_GraphsTuple_valid_none_fields: test the GraphsTuple class accepts valid None fields for nodes, edges, globals, receivers, and senders
test_GraphsTuple_map_fields: test the GraphsTuple.map method applies a function to specified fields and returns a new GraphsTuple
test_GraphsTuple_map_default: test the GraphsTuple.map method defaults to mapping EDGES, GLOBALS, and NODES fields when no fields argument is given
